facts.fact: Giovanni 通宵反复读父亲 2012 年的文章，又回地下室取后续期刊
facts.anchor: He spent the night reading and rereading his father’s article

facts.fact: 学界只有一篇一页的回应，把 Cavaterra 的理论斥为空想与幼稚
facts.anchor: there was only one response, a slight, one-page article that dismissed Professor Cavaterra’s theories as fantastical and puerile

facts.fact: 但那篇辱骂性的回应让 Giovanni 阴沉地承认自己看出其逻辑
facts.anchor: he has to gloomily admit that he sees the logic

facts.fact: 文章开篇描述 72 名精神分裂症患者共同以梦或幻觉看见的意象
facts.anchor: It opens with the description of an image, shared in the form of a dream or hallucination by seventy-two schizophrenics

facts.fact: 那意象是美丽而可怖的岛，住着一族儿童战士
facts.anchor: a beautiful, frightening island, full of delights but also of awful dangers, populated by (among other things) a tribe of child warriors

facts.fact: 多数患者想登岛却怕被孩子们攻击，于是留在挂海盗旗的大帆船上，由一个模糊的男人统领
facts.anchor: they stayed on board a galleon that bore a pirate flag, led by a vaguely defined man

facts.fact: 也有患者自称到过岛上：被锁在地下棚屋，受孩子们恶作剧与酷刑（两者不加区分）
facts.anchor: prisoners in underground hovels, chained to the rocks and tormented by children who subjected them to pranks and tortures

facts.fact: 文章第二部分：澳洲原住民相信人做梦时访问真实存在的地方
facts.anchor: Indigenous Australians, Cavaterra explains, believe that when human beings dream, they visit actual places

facts.fact: Cavaterra 认为萨满可能是对的：梦境与帆船或为真实之地，因精神分裂者的意识状态改变而可进入
facts.anchor: Cavaterra thought the shamans might be right

facts.fact: 文章结论：真实与想象的边界是意识形态的，人必须学会超越它
facts.anchor: the boundaries between real and imaginary are ideological, and we must learn how to transcend them

facts.fact: 四天之差让 Giovanni 站在父亲旧敌的位置上——只是 Luisa 的眼睛把他也变了
facts.anchor: Four days are all that separate Giovanni from his father’s old opponents

facts.fact: Giovanni 查通讯簿发现自己留着 Augusto 叔叔的号码
facts.anchor: He kept Uncle Augusto’s number

facts.fact: Michele 觉得 Greta 把父亲说成 normal 值得亲吻：此前无人做到
facts.anchor: No one before her, absolutely no one, has ever managed to define Papa as normal

facts.fact: Michele 的抽屉暗库现在有桃核与父亲的黑笔记本
facts.anchor: first the peach stone, now Papa’s black notebook too

facts.fact: 笔记本首页是两行英文诗句（Wiccan 诫律）
facts.anchor: These Eight words the Rede fulfil / An Ye harm none, do what Ye will

facts.fact: 笔记本反复提到未具名的 Horned God 与 Diana/Artemis 女神，还有 Nemi 的 Diana 神庙描写
facts.anchor: In several places it mentions an unspecified Horned God, always capitalized, and a goddess, interchangeably referred to as Diana or Artemis

facts.fact: 笔记里 2007 年的条目说 Irene 从水中看见 Silvia 将再有孩子——早于 Michele 出生
facts.anchor: Irene saw in the water that Silvia will have another child

facts.fact: Michele 家墙后发现 Nibs 的新涂鸦：与 EUR 那件杰作同一作者
facts.anchor: the same artist who did the graffiti in EUR

facts.fact: 涂鸦的整行文字是 He's coming back，图样里有岛、船、顶帽女孩、拄杖男人、从台伯河而出的裸女孩
facts.anchor: He’s coming back

facts.fact: Giovanni 在台伯岛上等下夜班的 Luisa——父亲行医、Luisa 当护士的医院
facts.anchor: He’s on the island in the Tiber, right in the middle of the river

facts.fact: Giovanni 犹豫未上前，Luisa 没发现他就走远了
facts.anchor: Luisa passes, without noticing him, and recedes into the distance

facts.fact: 医生断言 Wedge 的身体将永远瘫痪在床上
facts.anchor: according to the doctors, it’ll stay there forever

facts.fact: Dal Mare 在梦中被告知：不能飞，飞行是敌人的特权
facts.anchor: You will not fly, Dal Mare, the Captain, had told him, because that is the vile privilege of our enemies

facts.fact: Wedge 四足奔跑追踪入侵罗马的树木气味——入侵将至的预兆
facts.anchor: He runs four-legged through the city streets, following the trail already laid for him—the smell of trees invading Rome

facts.fact: 气味浓到物理性地把他击倒，像麻袋摔地
facts.anchor: The smell strikes him, lifts from the ground, and drops him to the earth like a rubbish sack

facts.fact: 第六节：Wendy 与 Giada 收养了那个长角的怪胎幼崽，取名 Peter
facts.anchor: The whelp is snoring on the floor

facts.fact: 幼崽吞牛奶鸡蛋连同容器蛋壳，连放了十五天的沙拉都吞了
facts.anchor: it was guzzling milk and eggs, devouring even the containers, shells, and everything else within reach

facts.fact: Wendy 以自己的戏法台词决定留下 Peter：奇想现身就不放行
facts.anchor: Those who let Wonder pass unseen, shall soon hear Death’s clock strike thirteen

facts.fact: 两天里 Peter 长成：每只手六指带剃刀利爪，能开罐如手术刀
facts.anchor: He has six fingers on each of his little hands, with long, razor sharp claws

facts.fact: Peter 咬穿了 Giada 自行车的橡胶轮胎
facts.anchor: he seems to love that of rubber tires, going by how he’s gnawed through the wheels of Giada’s bike

facts.fact: Giada 事故后发誓不坐任何少于四轮的机动车，开一辆旧 Panda
facts.anchor: Giada vowed not to place her behind on anything that had a motor and less than four wheels

facts.fact: 两女的目的地是 Giada 捡到 Peter 的 Pineto 公园
facts.anchor: Their goal was the Pineto Park where she found Peter

facts.fact: 她们靠近主入口旁的绿色垃圾斗
facts.anchor: They approach a green skip near one of the main entrances

facts.fact: 垃圾斗后是被防护网围住的危楼，像全世界最闹鬼的房子
facts.anchor: the most haunted house in the world

facts.fact: 一个流浪汉昨天在 Termini 对 Angela 嘶喊 he's coming back 然后哭了
facts.anchor: He wheezed in my face and shouted he’s coming back! Then he started crying

facts.fact: 公园里有截雕成人形的树桩，粗臂厚指，似要挣脱大地
facts.anchor: a sculpted stump

facts.fact: 公园洼地里是锡棚旅行者营地；圣彼得穹顶—板楼—赤贫三景同框
facts.anchor: there’s a travellers’ camp, made up of shacks with tin roofs

facts.fact: Wendy 提醒 Giada：营前那几个旅行者孩子带着刀剑
facts.anchor: “Swords and daggers, Giada. Those children were armed

facts.fact: Dal Mare 判定 Wedge 丢了踪迹，罚他三夜不得入梦（连睡眠一起没收）
facts.anchor: Wedge, that simpleton, has lost the trail

facts.fact: Dal Mare 在公园确证：敌人就是在此抵达 Flesh
facts.anchor: It is here that it happened, that his enemy arrived

facts.fact: Dal Mare 称 Wedge 为 his Hound
facts.anchor: his Hound

facts.fact: Giovanni 打车去 La Bufalotta 的 Uncle Augusto 豪宅，只为问父亲的事
facts.anchor: a quick chat about Papa is worth the cost of a taxi

facts.fact: Augusto 后花园立着一比一石雕大帆船 Galleon，细节精到如真船
facts.anchor: From the back garden rears the stern of the Galleon

facts.fact: Giovanni 发现花园帆船的帆与儿时记忆不符：原本是收帆的
facts.anchor: “Uncle,” he says, “didn’t the sails use to be furled?”

facts.fact: Augusto 称收帆是投降的象征
facts.anchor: A symbol of surrender.

facts.fact: Augusto 说那篇文章他烂熟于心
facts.anchor: I know it by heart, one might say

facts.fact: Augusto 说那篇文章同样终结了他与 Stefano 的友谊
facts.anchor: “It also marked the end of our friendship.”

facts.fact: Augusto 称 Stefano 曾警告儿子远离他，并发誓对方会听
facts.anchor: He swore to me that he would

facts.fact: Augusto 曾斥巨资资助 Stefano 的研究，目标是用药帮助病人，不能资助「告诉疯子他是对的」的研究
facts.anchor: I spent considerable sums on Stefano’s research

facts.fact: Giovanni 几乎相信 Augusto 的沉痛，唯独那改过的帆让他存疑
facts.anchor: If it weren’t for the sails of the Galleon, Giovanni would believe him

facts.fact: Giovanni 走后 Augusto 踱步懊恼：又是 Cavaterra 家的血
facts.anchor: Again the Cavaterra blood!

facts.fact: Augusto 庆幸 Giovanni 低估自己：低估你的敌人宝贵如盟友
facts.anchor: an enemy that underestimates you is as precious as an ally

facts.fact: Augusto 自陈：正是 Stefano 的研究给了船长准备、壮大与升级帆船的时间
facts.anchor: It had been his studies that gave the Captain time to prepare

facts.fact: Augusto 认出公园里的女孩是 Angela Cavaterra
facts.anchor: He’s worked out who that slip of a girl he saw in the park was: Angela Cavaterra

facts.fact: 夜袭 Pineto：敌人不在；Giancarlo 顶嘴后被 Dal Mare 手杖钩割喉杀死，Dal Mare 头也不看尸体重复 Look harder
facts.anchor: “Look harder,” repeats Dal Mare, without even looking at the corpse

facts.fact: 船长亲搜：棚屋里有笑脸儿童照片、项链、档案，但没有孩子、没有 Peter
facts.anchor: In one hovel he finds a photo of a smiling child

facts.fact: 是 Lost Boys 先到，提醒旅行者撤离并带走了 Peter
facts.anchor: The Lost Boys got here before him

facts.fact: Dal Mare 下令烧掉一切：得不到旅行者的现在，就剥他们的过去
facts.anchor: “Burn it all,” he orders
